import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
p=Path('/private/tmp/opc-value-agent-rx2w4xom/product-candidate/P01/project')
load=lambda name:list(csv.DictReader((p/name).open()))
dt=lambda s:datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
cutoff=dt('2026-10-26T00:00:00Z')
users=load('users.csv'); raw=load('events.csv'); payments=load('payments.csv')
external={u['account_id']:u for u in users if u['kind']=='external' and dt(u['first_exposed_at'])<=cutoff}
unique={}
for e in raw:
    if e['event_id'] in unique:
        assert e==unique[e['event_id']], 'conflicting duplicate'
    unique[e['event_id']]=e
assert all(e['account_id'] in {u['account_id'] for u in users} for e in unique.values())
events=[e for e in unique.values() if e['account_id'] in external and dt(external[e['account_id']]['first_exposed_at'])<=dt(e['at'])<=cutoff]
verified=[e for e in events if e['event']=='export_verified']
records=[]
for aid,u in external.items():
    start=dt(u['first_exposed_at']); lo=start+timedelta(days=7); hi=start+timedelta(days=14)
    hit=any(e['account_id']==aid and lo<=dt(e['at'])<hi for e in verified)
    state='immature' if hi>cutoff else 'unknown' if aid=='u5' else 'success' if hit else 'no_verified_value'
    records.append(dict(account=aid,segment=u['segment'],d7_start=lo.isoformat(),d7_end=hi.isoformat(),d7_state=state,ever_verified=any(e['account_id']==aid for e in verified),first7_mature=start+timedelta(days=7)<=cutoff,first7_verified=any(e['account_id']==aid and start<=dt(e['at'])<start+timedelta(days=7) for e in verified)))
mature=[r for r in records if r['d7_state']!='immature']
S=sum(r['d7_state']=='success' for r in mature); F=sum(r['d7_state']=='no_verified_value' for r in mature); U=sum(r['d7_state']=='unknown' for r in mature)
assert len(mature)==S+F+U
ledgers={}
for x in payments:
    assert x['account_id'] in external
    key=(x['transaction_id'],x['account_id'])
    if key not in ledgers: ledgers[key]={'paid':0,'refunded':0}
    ledgers[key][x['status']]+=int(x['amount_units'])
assert all(x['refunded']<=x['paid'] for x in ledgers.values())
by_account={a:sum(x['paid']-x['refunded'] for (t,u),x in ledgers.items() if u==a) for a in external}
result={'quality':{'user_rows':len(users),'external':len(external),'excluded_internal_bot':[u['account_id'] for u in users if u['account_id'] not in external],'raw_events':len(raw),'unique_events':len(unique),'retransmissions_removed':len(raw)-len(unique),'external_unique_events':len(events),'external_verified_events':len(verified)},'accounts':records,'first_value':{'ever_accounts':[r['account'] for r in records if r['ever_verified']],'ever_numerator':sum(r['ever_verified'] for r in records),'ever_denominator':len(records),'first7_success':sum(r['first7_verified'] for r in records if r['first7_mature']),'first7_mature':sum(r['first7_mature'] for r in records)},'d7':{'S':S,'F':F,'U':U,'mature':len(mature),'immature':len(records)-len(mature),'lower':S/len(mature),'upper':(S+U)/len(mature),'complete_case':S/(S+F)},'payments':{'transaction_ids':[t for t,a in ledgers],'historical_paid_accounts':sorted({a for (t,a),x in ledgers.items() if x['paid']>0}),'refunded_accounts':sorted({a for (t,a),x in ledgers.items() if x['refunded']>0}),'net_positive_accounts':[a for a,n in by_account.items() if n>0],'gross':sum(x['paid'] for x in ledgers.values()),'refunds':sum(x['refunded'] for x in ledgers.values()),'net':sum(x['paid']-x['refunded'] for x in ledgers.values())}}
assert (S,F,U,len(mature))==(2,3,1,6)
assert result['first_value']['ever_numerator']==6
assert result['payments']['net']==20
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
